Predict Suitability Across a Collection of Land-Use Scenarios

Source: R/scenarios.R
PredictScenarios.Rd

Applies PredictSuitability() to every member of a scenario SpatRasterCollection, using the same already-fitted models each time (see FitSpeciesModels()) – no refitting per scenario.

Usage

PredictScenarios(Models, Scenarios, categorical = NULL)

Arguments

Models

A named list of fitted maxnet models, one per species (the combined list across all species, not a single-species branch).

Scenarios

A SpatRasterCollection, as produced by load_scenario_collection() or make_landuse_scenarios().

categorical

Optional character vector naming which layer(s) are categorical. See SampleEnv().

Value

A SpatRasterCollection, one member per scenario, each member a multi-layer SpatRaster (one layer per species) of predicted suitability – directly comparable to a baseline stack built the same way from PredictSuitability().
